title: Juicy Light Jamaican Chicken Skewers
description: A light and refreshing Jamaican dish featuring chicken skewers with a yeasty flavor, perfect for a post-workout meal. This dish is nut-free and features tinned tomatoes.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yeast extract, olive oil, lime juice, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
In a small bowl, mix together chopped tinned tomatoes and sodium alginate.
Using a syringe, drop the tomato mixture into a bath of cold water to create spheres.
Serve the grilled chicken skewers with the tomato spheres.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
